definition: Each birth has independent rotated triples. After the actual +++ and --- support histories, sample motor logits in their common input plane at 72 angles. Contrast the odd response under opposite histories. Average across 0,120,240 degrees to isolate multiples of three; first harmonic cancels exactly. Third and higher terms refer to discrete angular harmonics. The last-tick decomposition projects the motor preactivation onto DC plus first harmonic before applying tanh; it is a signal analysis, not a lesion. At nonzero probe offsets the diagnostic asks whether the physical action assigned to the nearest trained odor is retained. Left-right actions use the original random draws.
